acceptanceModel: Automated route/state coverage plus representative actual screen-reader coverage of shared interaction patterns

representatives.represents: Public required-field form, validation, asynchronous submission and recovery feedback
representatives.actions: Submit empty/invalid email; correct to a synthetic test address; submit with a mocked successful response and one controlled failure. Hear labels, required/error feedback, progress and result; inspect focus after each.

representatives.represents: Policy reading regions, individual checkboxes, disabled/enabled acceptance and refreshed status
representatives.actions: Read each policy heading and checkbox in context; distinguish privacy acknowledgement from acceptance. Select the required policies, submit, hear the recorded result; exercise one controlled error and retry.

representatives.represents: Financial definition lists, booking state and consequential action confirmation
representatives.actions: Read a synthetic booking with money and payment status. Open an available cancellation/withdrawal confirmation, hear its consequence, then cancel the confirmation. Use a separate disposable fixture for a completed action and its feedback; never start real checkout.

representatives.represents: Marketplace card/list navigation and navigation back from detail
representatives.actions: Navigate by headings/links between two bookings and detail; return to the list. Hear venue, date, state and amounts without relying on color; verify context and focus after navigation.

representatives.role: owning verified Owner with REQUESTED bookings
representatives.represents: Owner decision buttons, busy state, authoritative refresh and conflict feedback
representatives.actions: On disposable requests, accept one and decline another using existing controls. Hear action names/consequences, loading and final state; exercise one controlled conflict/error and inspect focus. No payment is made.

representatives.represents: Long grouped editor, activity selects, instructions, validation and save result
representatives.actions: Navigate headings/fieldsets, activity selectors and form labels. Submit a missing required field, correct it, save a harmless synthetic text change and hear feedback. Check focus/error recovery and decorative photo announcements.

representatives.role: verified Owner; current policies accepted; synthetic verified destination
representatives.represents: Sensitive-data form, inline cancellation and pending/replacement explanation
representatives.actions: Open Change payout details, check field labels/instructions and required errors, then cancel. Using ONLY a synthetic test fixture, submit a replacement; hear under-review state and the explanation that the existing verified destination stays active. Do not record the full test IBAN.

representatives.represents: Shared admin shell, filter controls, table headers/cells and pagination
representatives.actions: Navigate table rows/cells with the reader, associate headers with values, filter, use Next/Previous and open a booking. Hear page context, loading and an empty result; recover from one controlled list error.

representatives.role: Admin; synthetic booking with events and monetary fields
representatives.represents: Complex section hierarchy, financial facts and independently loading pageable timeline
representatives.actions: Navigate Booking/Payment/Refund/Payout sections and event list. Hear amount/status labels including unavailable values. Exercise timeline error/retry while booking facts remain; paginate events and inspect focus.

representatives.represents: Sensitive inline reveal confirmation and focus return, without false modal semantics
representatives.actions: Open the existing reveal confirmation, hear its purpose/consequence, cancel and verify focus returns to its opener. Reopen and confirm using ONLY synthetic bank data; check reveal/error feedback. Record only a redacted description of announcements.

representatives.role: Admin; synthetic queue with severity/types and multiple pages
representatives.represents: Operational cards, textual severity, linked records and queue pagination
representatives.actions: Read exception severity, type, reason and related-record links. Navigate Next/Previous and a linked record; hear loading/empty/error feedback. Confirm no meaning depends on border color and no decorative content obscures the reason.

completion: Future accessibility/public-launch acceptance; not a current private-alpha/local gate.
coverageLimit: Pattern mapping combines with existing route-specific automation; it does not assert that every route is identical or has been used with AT. Actual representatives remain BLOCKED.
